'''2011 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Nick Reisch DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Nick Reisch]] at [[2011 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)|VB4-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Have Gun, Will Travel
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
